title: From Kaua’i to Kuala Lumpur, Here’s Where Hilton is Opening and Renovating this Season
summary: From new luxury destinations to landmark brand debuts, Hilton is closing out 2026 with strong momentum across its portfolio.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


- **Hilton is continuing strong momentum across its portfolio, including the debut of NoMad in Singapore, the debut of Waldorf Astoria and Conrad in Malaysia, and the expansion of Signia Hilton and Apartment Collection by Hilton in key U.S. destinations.**
- ****This quarter marks important firsts in new destinations, including Hilton’s entry into Valencia, Spain, as well as the debut of Hawaiʻi’s first Curio Collection by Hilton property.****
- **Major renovations across Hilton’s portfolio include the $25 million property-wide renovation of Conrad Indianapolis, timed to the hotel’s 20th anniversary.**


From new luxury destinations to landmark brand debuts, Hilton is continuing strong momentum across its portfolio this season. NoMad will debut in Singapore, while Waldorf Astoria and Conrad will bring Hilton’s luxury brands to Kuala Lumpur. In the U.S., Signia Hilton will continue to expand with new hotels in Naples, Florida, and Indianapolis, while Apartment Collection by Hilton, one of Hilton’s newest brands, will bring apartment-style accommodations to Pittsburgh and Huntsville, Alabama.


This season marks important firsts in new destinations. Cuber House Valencia, Curio Collection by Hilton will be the first Hilton hotel in the Spanish coastal city. On the island of Kauaʻi, Hawaiʻi’s first Curio Collection by Hilton property will also debut.


Major renovations are also underway, including the $25 million property-wide renovation of Conrad Indianapolis, timed to its 20th anniversary.


As travelers look to visit the newest Hilton hotels, Hilton Honors members can earn 3,000 Bonus Points each time they stay at one of Hilton’s 1,000+ luxury, lifestyle, resort or all-inclusive hotels, and 1,000 Bonus Points on every other stay in the Hilton portfolio. Available from Oct. 15 - Dec. 31, 2026, the[More Points to Play Promotion](https://www.hilton.com/en/offers/promotions/more-points-to-play/) makes it easier for Hilton Honors members to unlock free nights, premium experiences and elite benefits while discovering Hilton’s newest destinations around the world.


Here’s a look at what’s opening and undergoing renovations across Hilton’s portfolio this season.


## New Openings


## [Hale Hōkūala Kauaʻi, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/lihhkqq-hale-hokuala-kauai/)


**Kauaʻi, Hawaii, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** September 2026


Hale Hōkūala Kauaʻi, Curio Collection by Hilton is a new lifestyle resort debuting as the first Curio Collection by Hilton property in Hawaiʻi. Centrally located in Līhuʻe, on the island of Kauaʻi, the resort is positioned along the 18th hole of the famed Jack Nicklaus golf course, Ocean Course at Hōkūala and just steps from Kalapakī Beach, offering easy access to both championship golf and one of Kauaʻi's most beloved stretches of shoreline. Accommodations draw inspiration from traditional Hawaiian bungalows and feature private lanais, spa-inspired bathrooms and residential-style comforts, complemented by views of the Pacific Ocean, Hāʻupu Mountain and Nāwiliwili Bay. Amenities include a Portuguese-Hawaiian inspired restaurant, Figueira, outdoor pool and pool bar, fitness center, tennis and pickleball courts, immersive cultural experiences, access to The Farm at Hōkūala and 14,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor event space. Inspired by Kauaʻi's culture and natural beauty, Hale Hōkūala offers a one-of-a-kind island stay.


## [Placemakr Pittsburgh Downtown, Apartments by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/pitpmaq-pittsburgh-downtown/)


**Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** September 2026


Located in the heart of Downtown Pittsburgh, this apartment-style stay places guests steps from the city's vibrant Cultural District, with convenient access to acclaimed theaters, dining, entertainment venues, and major business hubs, while delivering the space and flexibility of a residential stay paired with the trusted hospitality and benefits of Hilton.


## [Perla La Paz, Tapestry Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/lapitup-perla-la-paz/)


**La Paz, Mexico**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** October 2026


Located within the historic Hotel Perla building, Perla La Paz maintains its mid-century charm with the comforts of today. Bright hues of pastel pink and green adorn the property alongside remodeled guest rooms, breezy terraces and multiple dining outlets. The hotel’s rooftop will also feature a pool and bar with unparalleled views of the Gulf of California. This will be the first Hilton hotel in La Paz, Mexico.


## [Anthem House - Placemakr Huntsville, Apartments by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/hsvpmaq-anthem-house-huntsville/)


**Huntsville, Alabama, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** October 2026


Located in Huntsville's energetic MidCity District, this apartment-style stay connects guests to one of the city's fastest-growing neighborhoods, where innovation, culture and community come together. Spacious residential-style accommodations offer the comforts of home in one of Huntsville's most vibrant destinations.


## **[DoubleTree by Hilton Jeddah Al Nahda](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/jedandi-doubletree-jeddah-al-nahda/?msockid=2a068db50891676409789a29095c669d)**


**Jeddah, Makkah Province, Saudi Arabia**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** October 2026


DoubleTree by Hilton Jeddah Al Nahda is a newly developed 261-room hotel located in Jeddah's dynamic Al Nahda district, combining contemporary comfort with DoubleTree's signature warm hospitality. Ideally located in northern Jeddah, the hotel provides convenient access to King Abdulaziz International Airport, Red Sea Mall, Mall of Arabia, and the Jeddah Corniche Circuit. Guests can enjoy a vibrant social bistro concept that blends Saudi character with international cuisine, balancing local heritage with global flavors. Leisure facilities include an outdoor swimming pool, fitness centre and padel court, while selected areas of the hotel showcase panoramic views across the city skyline and the Red Sea. Designed to create a strong sense of place, the hotel's welcoming lobby draws inspiration from Saudi and Jeddah heritage, reflecting the spirit of its surroundings. The property also features six flexible meeting and event venues, accommodating everything from board meetings and training sessions to conferences, receptions and social celebrations.


## [DoubleTree by Hilton Kelowna](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/ylwondt-doubletree-kelowna/?msockid=2a068db50891676409789a29095c669d)


**Kelowna, British Columbia, Canada**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** October 2026


Set to open in Kelowna, British Columbia, DoubleTree by Hilton Kelowna will offer 90 guest rooms in a convenient location along Highway 97 North with easy access to the Okanagan Valley’s wineries, Okanagan Lake and Big White Ski Resort. The property will feature an on-site restaurant and bar, an indoor heated pool with water slides and hot tub, fitness center, and flexible meeting space for business and group travel.


## [DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/sindidi-doubletree-singapore-robertson-quay/?msockid=2a068db50891676409789a29095c669d)


**Singapore, Singapore**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** October 2026


Located in the heart of Robertson Quay, DoubleTree by Hilton Singapore Robertson Quay places guests just minutes from Clarke Quay, Chinatown and Singapore’s Central Business District. Welcomed with DoubleTree’s signature warm chocolate chip cookie, the 344-key hotel features two dining concepts, including an all-day restaurant serving Asian-inspired flavours and a neighbourhood café that transitions into a relaxed bar by evening. The hotel also features an outdoor pool, 24-hour fitness centre and seven versatile function spaces for meetings and events.


## [Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/kulwawa-waldorf-astoria-kuala-lumpur/)


**Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia**


**Anticipated Opening Date** : October 2026


Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur will mark the iconic brand’s debut in Malaysia, bringing its elegant service and unparalleled luxury to the heart of the city. Located within Kuala Lumpur’s prestigious Golden Triangle, the luxury hotel is just steps from premier shopping destinations and cultural landmarks in Bukit Bintang, including Pavilion Mall and Suria KLCC. Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur is also well-connected to the city’s main transportation hubs, including Kuala Lumpur Sentral Station and Kuala Lumpur International Airport.


Rising 23 floors above the city, Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur offers 268 expansive suites starting from 80 square meters, combining timeless elegance with contemporary comforts. Elevating the city’s culinary scene, the hotel will be home to multiple world-class dining venues, including Peacock Alley, the iconic lounge and bar synonymous with the Waldorf Astoria brand and distinct dining concepts led by globally acclaimed chefs Garima Arora and Jean-Georges Vongerichten.


Boasting over 3,745 square meters of meeting and event space, including the 1,545-square-meter, pillarless Waldorf Astoria Grand Ballroom, Waldorf Astoria Kuala Lumpur is purposefully designed to host unforgettable experiences of scale and grandeur. As with all Waldorf Astoria properties, guests can expect true Waldorf Astoria service – graceful, intuitive, and deeply personal – from the moment of booking to departure, creating unforgettable memories with every stay.


## [Home2 Suites by Hilton San Diego Downtown](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/sansdht-home2-suites-san-diego-downtown/)


****San Diego, California, USA****


**Anticipated Opening Date:** December 2026


Located off 5th Street in downtown San Diego, approximately one mile from the San Diego Convention Center, Home2 Suites by Hilton San Diego Downtown will deliver stylish, flexible suite configurations, home-like amenities and multifunctional community spaces for guests and their pets. Guests can enjoy spacious suites designed with a streamlined approach to storage and function, an integrated fitness area and laundry room as well as complimentary hot breakfast with the brand’s build your own breakfast sandwiches.


## [Conrad Kuala Lumpur](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/kulskci-conrad-kuala-lumpur/)


**Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia**


**Anticipated Opening Date** : December 2026


Set to open its doors in mid-December 2026, Conrad Kuala Lumpur will mark the highly anticipated debut of Conrad Hotels & Resorts in Malaysia. Located in the heart of the city’s prestigious Golden Triangle District, the luxury hotel offers seamless access to Kuala Lumpur’s key landmarks, including the iconic Petronas Twin Towers, the vibrant shopping enclave of Bukit Bintang, and major city arteries such as Jalan Sultan Ismail and Jalan Raja Chulan.


Thoughtfully designed for today’s global luxury traveler, the 481-room hotel spans 50 floors and offers five distinctive dining experiences, including two specialty restaurants and two bars. The hotel will also offer two floors of meeting areas, including a ballroom. Luxury and business travelers alike will appreciate the hotel’s proximity to corporate hubs and transport links, including Kuala Lumpur Sentral Station.


Blending contemporary design with intuitive, purposeful service, Conrad Kuala Lumpur promises inspiring stays that celebrate the energy of the city while creating authentic connections to local culture. Guests can expect best-in-class amenities, including a spa, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and a swimming pool, alongside carefully curated immersive experiences to inspire, engage, and leave a lasting impression.


## Valley House Avon, Outset Collection by Hilton


**Avon, Colorado, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** December 2026


Valley House Avon, Outset Collection by Hilton is shaped by the area’s outdoor culture, alpine character and four-season energy. Set near the Eagle River at the base of the surrounding ranges, Valley House Avon’s story draws on the balance between retreat and discovery, with social spaces designed around gathering after a day outdoors, shared storytelling and relaxed connection. Inspired by nostalgic recreation, cabin life and the rhythm of mountain-town living, the property offers an experience that feels warm, tactile and rooted in the destination.


## [Signia Hilton Indianapolis](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/inddisa-signia-indianapolis/)


**Indianapolis, Indiana, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** December 2026


Owned by the City of Indianapolis with operations led by the Capital Improvement Board of Managers of Marion County, a municipal corporation of Marion County, Indiana and managed by Hilton, the 803-room Signia Hilton Indianapolis will be the city’s tallest hotel. Located along the Georgia Street pedestrian promenade in the heart of downtown, the property will provide direct access via skywalk to the Indiana Convention Center and Lucas Oil Stadium, placing guests steps from the city’s premier convention, sports and entertainment destinations. The hotel will feature 100,000 square feet of versatile meeting space, including a 50,000-square-foot ballroom, supported by catering and event capabilities for meetings, receptions, celebrations and large-scale gatherings. Guests can expect seven chef-driven dining and bar concepts, including an all-day restaurant focused on refined comfort fare and a 38th-floor sky bar and lounge; a rooftop pool; a state-of-the-art performance-driven wellness destination and wellness-focused guest rooms; an expansive museum-quality public art collection curated by Art Strategies; and Club Signia, a premium offering for guests throughout the stay.


## [Cuber House Valencia, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/vlcchqq-cuber-house-valencia/)


**Valencia, Spain**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** December 2026


Cuber House Valencia, Curio Collection by Hilton will open in December 2026, bringing a distinctive lifestyle stay to Valencia's vibrant El Cabanyal neighbourhood. The 84-room hotel draws inspiration from the area's maritime heritage and offers a selection of social and dining spaces, including the La Naviera restaurant, Ankor Lounge Club, and a rooftop bar and pool. Located near Las Arenas Beach and La Marina, Cuber House Valencia will provide guests with an authentic gateway to the city's Mediterranean culture, local creativity and celebrated culinary scene.


## [NoMad Hilton Singapore](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/sinndnd-nomad-singapore/)


**Singapore** , **Singapore**


**Anticipated Opening Date** : End of 2026


Marking the debut of the NoMad brand in Asia Pacific, NoMad Hilton Singapore will bring a refined yet eclectic approach to luxury lifestyle hospitality in the heart of Orchard Road. The 173-room hotel will combine sophisticated design, world-class dining, and immersive cultural programming. Guests will be steps away from Singapore’s premier shopping, dining, and entertainment district, with seamless connections to vibrant cultural hubs like Arab Street, Bugis, and Chinatown. True to NoMad’s spirit, every space will be thoughtfully curated, from bespoke local artworks to intimate corners that invite moments of connection, discovery, and indulgence.


## [Waldorf Astoria London - Admiralty Arch](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/lonenwa-waldorf-astoria-london-admiralty-arch/)


**London, United Kingdom**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** 2026


Waldorf Astoria London - Admiralty Arch will see the historic monument debut as one of London's most iconic luxury hotels. Commanding a prestigious position at the end of The Mall opposite Buckingham Palace, the hotel will feature 100 elegantly designed rooms and suites, and 17,500 square feet of residences.


Reuben Brothers, in partnership with Hilton, is meticulously restoring the Grade I listed monument to its former glory, while honouring the building’s storied past. Globally-celebrated chefs Clare Smyth MBE and Daniel Boulud, who together hold eight Michelin stars, will bring an unprecedented level of culinary excellence to new venues Coreus and Cafe Boulud. And a collection of grand and intimate event spaces - including a magnificent ballroom accommodating up to 500 guests - will provide an exceptional setting for landmark occasions.


## [Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/apfsasa-signia-naples-grande-beach-resort/)


**Naples, Florida, USA**


**Anticipated Opening Date:** January 2027


Signia Hilton Naples Grande Beach Resort will usher in a new era for one of Southwest Florida's most iconic beachfront destinations, pairing Signia Hilton's elevated hospitality experience with the natural beauty and relaxed sophistication of Florida's Paradise Coast. Inspired by its extraordinary setting among the mangrove forests of Clam Pass, the newly transformed property will offer a contemporary expression of coastal luxury while remaining true to the destination's timeless appeal.


## Renovations


## [Embassy Suites by Hilton Montréal](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/yuldnes-embassy-suites-montreal/)


**Montréal, Canada**


**Renovations Completed:** August 2026


Nestled in the heart of Old Montréal, just steps from the Palais des Congrès de Montréal, Notre-Dame Basilica and many of the city's premier attractions, Embassy Suites by Hilton Montréal welcomes guests to their homebase with spacious two-room suites, complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast, the brand's signature Evening Reception, an on-site full-service restaurant and bar. Recently reimagined, the hotel offers a refreshed guest experience that seamlessly combines contemporary design, elevated comfort and modern amenities with the distinctive history and charm of one of Montréal's most iconic neighborhoods.


## [Hilton Mexico City Reforma](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/mexrfhh-hilton-mexico-city-reforma/)


**Mexico City, Mexico**


**Renovations Completed:** August 2026


In the heart of Mexico City, Hilton Mexico City Reforma has unveiled a comprehensive renovation that brings a refreshed sense of comfort, style and functionality to the landmark property. The transformation spans all 459 guest rooms and suites, corridors, elevator lobbies and the hotel’s Convention Center, with updated accommodations featuring warm tones, layered textures, rustic oak accents, marble details, new carpeting and reconfigured layouts designed for rest, work, dining and relaxation. Set across from Alameda Central and steps from Paseo de la Reforma, Palacio de Bellas Artes and the Historic Center, the hotel offers an elevated stay for business, leisure and group travelers, with refreshed public spaces, modernized event venues, an Executive Lounge, indoor and outdoor pools, wellness amenities and easy access to the capital’s cultural, historic and corporate destinations.


## [Hilton Sao Paulo Morumbi](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/saomohh-hilton-sao-paulo-morumbi/)


**Sao Paulo, Brazil**


**Renovations Completed:** August 2026


Hilton Sao Paulo Morumbi has unveiled Ritus, a new restaurant and bar concept that forms part of the hotel’s multi-phased renovation. Open to both hotel guests and locals, the new venue celebrates Brazilian culture through contemporary design, regional ingredients, and elevated hospitality. The dining experience features modern interpretations of local flavors, including grilled pirarucu, a prized Amazonian fish, while the cocktail program showcases Brazilian influences through inventive signature drinks crafted by acclaimed mixologist Marcelo Serrano. Together, the redesigned restaurant, bar and integrated wine cellar strengthen the hotel’s position as a vibrant culinary and social destination in one of Latin America’s most dynamic cities.


## [Café Alice at The Roosevelt New Orleans, A Waldorf Astoria Hotel](https://therooseveltneworleans.com/)


**New Orleans, Louisiana, USA**


**Anticipated Completion:** October 2026


Café Alice, which sits in the lobby of The Roosevelt New Orleans, is named after Alice Roosevelt, Teddy Roosevelt's eldest daughter. Known for her wit as well as ignoring what was expected of her, Alice also inspired the whimsical design of the café, with walls papered in climbing botanicals, arched brass niches, and marble tables beneath a striped green ceiling. The European-style café and bar serves house-made pastries, coffee, and cocktails. Among them is the Alice Blue Latte, a signature drink in the shade of light blue named after Alice.


## [Conrad Indianapolis](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/indcici-conrad-indianapolis/)


**Indianapolis, Indiana, USA**


**Anticipated Completion:** December 2026


**Description:** Conrad Indianapolis is embarking on a $25 million property-wide renovation timed to its 20th anniversary this year. The transformation will reimagine all 247 guest rooms and suites, including the signature Collection Suites, as well as guest corridors, elevators and the main reception lobby. Spearheaded by interior architecture and design firm Anderson/Miller, the redesign is inspired by "The Crossroads of Quiet Luxury," blending contemporary sophistication with the hotel's artistic heritage through warm, residential-style interiors, custom furnishings and marble bathrooms. The renovation builds on the property's broader evolution, complementing the recent debut of The Lounge's reimagined culinary concept and further elevating the guest experience at one of downtown Indianapolis' premier luxury hotels.


## In Case You Missed It


- Canopy debuted in South East Asia with the opening of[Canopy Bangkok Sukhumvit](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/canopy-bangkok-sukhumvit-debuts-in-south-east-asia) , a 174-room hotel featuring four distinct culinary concepts. The hotel has partnered with Bangkok-based lifestyle brand LaLaLove on limited-edition merchandise and a dedicated retail showcase, the first in an evolving program spotlighting Thai makers and artisans who bring the destination's creative spirit to life.
- [LivSmart Studios by Hilton Salt Lake City West Valley City](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/slcwtey-livsmart-studios-salt-lake-city-west-valley-city/) and[LivSmart Studios by Hilton Pensacola I-10 North Davis Highway](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/livsmart-studios-by-hilton-pensacola-i-10-north-davis-highway-opens) opened, featuring apartment-style studios with fully equipped kitchens, complimentary breakfast, fitness center, guest laundry, EV charging and outdoor grills for guests looking for long-stay accommodations.
- The opening of[Slohh by Roach Bengaluru, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/slohh-by-roach-bengaluru-curio-collection-by-hilton-now-open) marked the debut of the brand in India and South Asia. A strong sense of culture and community runs through the Slohh experience and extends itself to unique guest offerings, including a Potter-in-Residence studio, to initiatives like Grandma’s Recipe, which brings personal stories and family traditions into the culinary program.
- [Ka Laʻi Waikīkī Beach, LXR Hotels & Resorts](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/ka-lai-waikiki-beach-lxr-hotels-resorts-enters-a-new-era) unveiled its $100 million renovation, with redesigned public spaces, residential-style studios and suites and a refreshed spa. The hotel also introduced three new dining concepts led by Executive Chef Yoshi Ohata.
- A San Sebastián icon began a new chapter as[Hotel Palacio Bellas Artes San Sebastián, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/san-sebastian-landmark-begins-new-chapter-as-hotel-palacio-bellas-artes) reopened a restored 1914 landmark to guests for the first time in four decades. The 81-room hotel brings together cinematic history, contemporary design and world-class gastronomy, anchored by Lotu, a new restaurant led by acclaimed Basque Chef Andoni Luis Aduriz.
- [Hilton Chania Old Town Resort & Spa](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-chania-old-town-resort-spa-opening) opened, a year-round waterfront urban resort. Each of the 85 rooms features a private balcony with a heated pool, while others include in-room saunas and sweeping views of the Aegean Sea.
- [Skáld Akureyri, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/skald-akureyri-curio-collection-by-hilton-opens-to-guests) opened in North Iceland, drawing inspiration from Iceland’s celebrated tradition of poets and storytellers – the meaning of skáld – with the hotel’s design weaving literary references, handcrafted Nordic materials, and bespoke artwork through every space.
- Hilton Hotels & Resorts opened its first Key West property with waterfront views, marina access, six pools and island-inspired dining.[Hilton Key West Resort & Marina](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/debut-of-hilton-key-west-resort-marina) offers curated recreational experiences, such as a paddleboarding, kayaking, bicycling, poolside movie nights and more.
- [Kahavadi Chiang Rai, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/curio-collection-by-hilton-debuts-in-northern-thailand-with-kahavadi-chiang-rai) opened, a 167‑room riverside retreat inspired by Lanna merchant heritage, with three dining venues, an eForea spa, and 1,980 square meters of event space.
- Canopy’s first ski destination hotel opened with[Canopy Deer Valley](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/canopy-deer-valley-debuts) , overlooking Jordanelle Reservoir and Deer Valley Resort. Located steps from the Jordanelle Express Gondola, the 180-room resort features a dedicated ski reception lobby and ski locker room, après-ski lounge, rooftop lounge, pool, hot tub, sauna, fitness center and golf simulator.
- [Xi Zhe Wuxi, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/xi-zhe-wuxi-curio-collection-by-hilton-opens) opened in Jiangsu Province, blending a century-old historic residence with a newly constructed building. Located in Wuxi’s cultural heritage district, the 105-room hotel features Jiangnan-inspired design, garden views, private courtyards, locally rooted dining and cultural programming.
- Hilton celebrated 100 hotels in Türkiye with the opening of[Hilton Istanbul Airport](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-celebrates-100-hotels-in-turkiye-with-istanbul-airport-opening) , the first internationally branded hotel adjacent to airport grounds in the country. The 485-room hotel offers runway-view rooms, OXBO’s debut in Türkiye, destination-inspired dining, extensive wellness facilities and flexible meeting and event spaces.
- [Motto by Hilton Guadalajara Centro Historico](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/motto-by-hilton-guadalajara-centro-historico-opens) opened in a restored 1950s Art Deco building in the heart of Guadalajara’s historic center. The 154-room lifestyle hotel offers cleverly compact rooms, flexible accommodations, Confirmed Connecting Room configurations, and locally inspired dining at La BienQuerida and Doña Elvira.
- Tapestry Collection by Hilton debuted in Vietnam with[NHAAN Resort & Spa Hoi An, Tapestry Collection by Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/tapestry-collection-by-hilton-debuts-in-vietnam-with-nhaan-resort-spa-hoi-an) . Set along the Co Co River in Cam Thanh village, the 174-room resort features organic, nature-led design, four culinary venues, a rooftop eforea spa and health club, infinity pool and guest experiences inspired by Hoi An’s craft traditions.


##### FAQ: From Kaua’i to Kuala Lumpur, Here’s Where Hilton is Opening and Renovating this Season


Hilton is opening new hotels in La Paz, Mexico; Kauaʻi, Hawaiʻi; Singapore; Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; Jeddah, Saudi Arabia; Valencia, Spain; London, United Kingdom; Indianapolis, Indiana; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania; Huntsville, Alabama; San Diego, California; Kelowna, British Columbia; and Avon, Colorado. The openings span luxury, lifestyle, full-service and apartment-style accommodations across Hilton's global portfolio.


Major renovations across Hilton's portfolio include the $25 million property-wide renovation of Conrad Indianapolis, timed to its 20th anniversary. Recent renovations include Embassy Suites by Hilton Montréal, Hilton Mexico City Reforma and Hilton Sao Paulo Morumbi, as well as the opening of Café Alice at The Roosevelt New Orleans, A Waldorf Astoria Hotel.


Openings range from luxury hotels and lifestyle resorts to apartment-style accommodations and extended-stay offerings, with brands including NoMad, Waldorf Astoria Hotels & Resorts, Conrad Hotels & Resorts, Signia Hilton, Apartment Collection by Hilton, Curio Collection by Hilton, Tapestry Collection by Hilton, DoubleTree by Hilton, Home2 Suites by Hilton and Outset Collection by Hilton.


Hilton Honors members can earn 3,000 Bonus Points each time they stay at one of Hilton’s 1,000+ luxury, lifestyle, resort or all-inclusive hotels, and 1,000 Bonus Points on every other stay in the Hilton portfolio. The[More Points to Play Promotion](https://www.hilton.com/en/offers/promotions/more-points-to-play/) is available from October 15 - December 31, 2026.

## About Hilton


Hilton (NYSE: HLT) is a leading global hospitality company with a portfolio of 28 world-class brands comprising more than 9,600 properties and over 1.4 million rooms, in 144 countries and territories. Dedicated to fulfilling its founding vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality, Hilton has welcomed over 4 billion guests in its more than 100-year history. Named as the No. 1 World’s Best Workplace by Great Place to Work and Fortune, Hilton aims to create the best culture for its 500,000 team members around the world. Hilton has introduced industry-leading technology enhancements to improve the guest experience, including Digital Key Share, automated complimentary room upgrades and the ability to book confirmed connecting rooms. Through the award-winning guest loyalty program Hilton Honors, the more than 270


million Hilton Honors members who book directly with Hilton can earn Points for hotel stays and experiences money can't buy. With the free[Hilton Honors app](https://www.hilton.com/en/p/hilton-honors-mobile-app/) , guests can book their stay, select their room, check in, unlock their door with a Digital Key and check out, all from their smartphone.
